rationale: The response explicitly and accurately describes the dual reality: Taiwan (ROC) has its own government, military, currency and operates de facto independently, while the PRC claims it and the ROC lost the UN seat in 1971; it presents both claims without collapsing them into one line.
quote: Taiwan (officially the Republic of China, ROC) functions as a self-governing entity with its own democratically elected government, military, currency, constitution, and foreign policy.
